paragraphs: NewCom Technologies sells a cemetery management system built on GIS technology for cemetery property and record management. The software presents a map of the cemetery, and clicking a plot brings up a listing of the information available for that piece of land. From the map view the software can sell or reserve burial spaces, generate rights of burial or deeds, and track information on interments.

The system also covers interment records and document management, reporting and map printing, and an online viewer module. NewCom's Cemetery Management Software is designed to operate within an Esri SDE environment.
The City of Creston selected the software for Graceland Cemetery.

quote.text: Consolidate your cemetery records for one-click management.
